name: docs
title: Docs
description: A technical manual. Contents tree on the left from the pages directory, the article in the middle, an outline on the right, search in the header, callouts, and a version badge. No plugins.
features: Contents from SMGen's tree menu over the pages directory
Search through smgen-search when it is installed
Note, tip and warning callouts from fenced divs
Version badge and edit link in the masthead
System light and dark with a toggle

sampleContent.purpose: One page per command, grouped in the contents
About page; says the product is a demo

notes: Set DOCS_VERSION and DOCS_REPOSITORY in .smgen.yaml for the masthead badge and edit links
Search needs the smgen-search package on the build machine; the theme hides the box when it is not
